title: FapIotAiRoleCredential
description: Role credential of a person using the FAP IoT & AI. Issued via OID4VCI to the user's wallet; presented via OID4VP at the Keycloak wallet login. Personal data is limited to name, email, organisation DID and roles; no further personal claims are allowed. Draft 0.2.

id.description: Holder DID (wallet key). Becomes 'sub' of the brokered login.

name.description: Display name. Selectively disclosable when SD-JWT is enabled.

email.description: Email address. Selectively disclosable when SD-JWT is enabled.

org_did.description: DID of the participant organisation the person acts for; must be the subject of a valid FacisParticipantCredential. Mapped to the token claim org_did.

roles.description: FAP roles. Mapped to realm roles and the token claim roles.

purposes.description: Optional: purposes the person may declare. Mapped to the token claim purpose; evaluated by the policy agent for lakehouse and AI access. Not personal data.
